nodes.name: FindMarchSpotifyPayment
nodes.role: find the March payment to Spotify in the transaction history and extract its amount

nodes.name: ReadPriceIncreaseNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price increase notice the user received and extract the stated percentage

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: compute the shortfall by applying the stated increase to the March payment amount and subtracting the amount actually paid

nodes.name: ConfirmPayment
nodes.role: get the user's approval of the payee and the computed shortfall amount before any money moves

nodes.name: PaySpotifyDifference
nodes.role: pay Spotify exactly the approved shortfall amount, and no more
